description.from:
# Papyrus integration via editorial SDK

## Intent

Once the standalone package exists, Papyrus (and Tactus procedures) invoke it through the **SDK**, injecting publication style profiles and drafts from Papyrus config — not by owning the editorial core.

## Done when

- Newsroom / publication workflows call the SDK, not in-tree `papyrus_content.editorial_*` cores.
- Style profiles from Papyrus map cleanly into the standalone config format.
- Automated procedures can diagnose + propose options; human gates for apply/publish remain.
- In-tree editorial core is removed or reduced to a deprecated shim.

# Papyrus integration via Limatus SDK

## Intent

Papyrus (and Tactus procedures) invoke **Limatus** through the SDK, injecting publication style profiles and drafts from Papyrus config — not owning the editorial core.

## Done when

- Newsroom / publication workflows call the Limatus SDK, not in-tree `papyrus_content.editorial_*` cores.
- Papyrus style profiles map into Limatus config.
- Automated procedures can diagnose + propose options; human gates for apply/publish remain.
- In-tree editorial core is removed or reduced to a deprecated shim.
